key_values.event_name: 2024 East Africa exceptional rainfall and floods

acceptable_variants: May describe the hazard as pluvial or flash flooding caused by persistent seasonal rainfall.
May round rainfall values to one decimal place or describe them as approximately 84 mm regional mean and 117 mm point total.
May call the priority tier 'very high flood life-safety response' if the exact tier label and index are also recoverable.
judge_anchors.canonical_stance: Classify the incident as exceptional seasonal rainfall and flooding in East Africa, enhanced by El Nino/positive Indian Ocean Dipole moisture context, with a very high life-safety flood response priority.
forbidden_claims: Treating heat stress, wind damage, drought, or annual land-cover change as the primary East Africa event mechanism.
Reporting exact all-country mortality totals or formal hydrologic return periods not supported by the task record.
Using the low annual embedding-change value to claim that no flood damage occurred.
Treating the exposure slice as a complete census of every affected community.
required_claims: Identifies exceptional seasonal rainfall and flooding as the dominant disaster mechanism.
Links the rainfall context to El Nino, a positive Indian Ocean Dipole, and warm north-west Indian Ocean conditions.
Uses both rainfall magnitude and rainfall persistence to justify flood severity.
Connects flood warnings or casualty/injury language to a life-safety response priority.
Uses bounded exposure context, including population and critical amenities, without treating it as exact realized loss.

required_metrics.derivation: Mean of GPM and CHIRPS event accumulated precipitation means.
required_metrics.name: regional_precip_mean_mm

required_metrics.derivation: Mean of Open-Meteo and NASA POWER event-window point totals.
required_metrics.name: point_precip_total_mm

required_metrics.derivation: Conservative minimum count of days with at least 5 mm/day across the two point samples.
required_metrics.name: heavy_rain_days

required_metrics.derivation: Conservative minimum longest run of days with at least 5 mm/day across the two point samples.
required_metrics.name: heavy_rain_run_days

required_metrics.derivation: WorldPop population sum for the event exposure context.
required_metrics.name: population_exposed

required_metrics.derivation: OSM hospital, clinic, school, and shelter count in the bounded exposure slice.
required_metrics.name: critical_amenities

criteria.description: Gives the exact dominant mechanism label, assigns `very_high_life_safety_flood_response`, and reports priority index 100.
criteria.name: Exact structured classification
criteria.partial_credit: Award up to 2 points for an equivalent rainfall-flood mechanism without the exact label, and up to 1 additional point for a high or very-high tier with an approximate index.

criteria.description: Reports the regional precipitation mean of 83.5 mm, the point total of 116.7 mm, and recognizes that GPM/CHIRPS plus point samples agree on substantial rainfall.
criteria.name: Rainfall magnitude anchors
criteria.partial_credit: Award 2-3 points for approximately correct rainfall values with minor rounding or omitted source pairing; award 1 point for only qualitative heavy-rain language.

criteria.description: Uses 8 heavy-rain days, a 6-day run, and the 40+25+20+15 scoring structure to explain why the priority index reaches 100.
criteria.name: Persistence and priority scoring
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points for recognizing persistent rainfall or top-tier priority without reconstructing the full scoring logic.

criteria.description: Explains the chain from El Nino, positive Indian Ocean Dipole, and warm Indian Ocean conditions to enhanced seasonal rainfall and flash or pluvial flooding.
criteria.name: Physical driver and flood process
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points for naming the rainfall-flood process but missing one or more climate-mode drivers.

criteria.description: Connects flood warnings or casualty/injury text with 43,914 exposed people, 6 critical amenities, and the resulting life-safety/access-disruption priority.
criteria.name: Exposure and life-safety interpretation
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points for mentioning exposure or warnings without tying them to the response priority, or for using population/asset figures with small transcription errors.

criteria.description: Rejects heat, drought, wind, and annual land-cover change as primary mechanisms and avoids unsupported mortality, complete-exposure, or return-period overclaims.
criteria.name: Competing mechanisms and uncertainty
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1 point for rejecting some competing mechanisms but making a minor unsupported escalation.

criteria.description: Provides the requested JSON-like structure with a coherent three-step impact chain.
criteria.name: Concise structured response
criteria.partial_credit: Award 0.5 points for a mostly complete structure with minor formatting omissions.
